name: Four Seasons Cairo at The First Residence
insider_take: This ultra-modern Four Seasons stands as Cairo's tallest residential tower, offering unparalleled Nile views from the heart of the ancient city where pharaohs once ruled.
whats_special: Located in The First Residence, this sleek tower rises 43 floors above Cairo, making it one of Africa's tallest hotels. The property features stunning panoramic views of the Nile River, the Citadel, and the sprawling cityscape. Its prime location in the upscale First Settlement district puts you just minutes from Cairo's financial hub while maintaining easy access to the Pyramids of Giza and historic Islamic Cairo.
pro_tip: Book a Nile-facing room on the upper floors for breathtaking sunset views over the world's longest river, especially magical during the golden hour when the ancient city glows.
dont_miss: The hotel's sky-high spa and infinity pool offer a serene escape with dramatic city vistas. Take advantage of the concierge's insider access to private pyramid tours at dawn, and don't skip the rooftop dining experience where you can see the Great Pyramids illuminated in the distance on clear evenings.
pros: Exceptional Four Seasons luxury service and amenities
Prime Giza location with easy access to pyramids and attractions
Elegant residential-style suites with premium furnishings
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Limited availability due to exclusive residential concept
